name: interpolation
title: Animation Interpolation
description: s6-interp (the owner, 2026-10-03): the Experimental tab's Animation Interpolation, a test setting. On, the object layer draws in-between pictures between a creature's or a spell effect's frames (Quick, Balanced or Best; Frames 2 doubles them). Drawing only: the animations' frames and timing stay the logic's, and nothing is sent. The host's side is C# (TK.Objects.AnimationInterpolation).
